fields_2.label: Trial team embarked onboard for Op checks of Rukmani ‘C’/ ‘Ku’ Band (LSST) at hrs.MoD(N)/PDNSO approved schedule CM/1777 dated 05 Feb 14{MMT(E) MMT/341/RUKMANI dated 06 Jun 12} and CNO. 07/10 are enumerated in succeeding paragraphs :-

cells.value: Check all accessorise as per supply voucher
Check on board spares as per supply voucher
Check tools and Test Instruments as per list
Check fitment of the equipment ADE & BDE.
Check earthing of ADE & BDE equipment.
Check RF cable from ADE to CCU is properly connected
Check Rack and UPS are installed on shock mounts.
All the interconnecting cables and power cables are labelled.
Check that there is no blockage towards Satellite.
Check CCU. System will start initializing and displays GUI with 360 sec countdown.
Modem/ Router/ VoIP Gateway/ Encrypter/ Managed Ethernet Switch/ Network Accelerator/ IP Phones/ VC Equipment/ LCD Display/ Speaker/ Printer power LED are Solid Green/ Green.
Check CCU systems status field, check IRD Lock available.

cells.lb: Record AGC value in Bar Graph dBm (> -68dBm)

cells.value: Check Modem Rx/ Tx/ LAN LED blinks intermittently and system LED is OFF
Ping the Master IP Gateway at Hub.

cells.lb: Feed ship’s position Lat & Long manually at CCU, (time taken to acquire the satellite)
